title: Sequential blood-pressure triangle orientation did not establish improved cross-cycle prediction of urinary albumin
abstract: In exploratory NHANES 2009–2010 to 2015–2016 transfer (n=4527/4230), adding normalized systolic–diastolic triangle orientation changed survey-weighted log-UACR MSE from 0.81244624 to 0.81311055 (delta +0.00066431; joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap 95% [-0.04543142, +0.03137612]). Incremental predictive benefit was not established; uncertainty allows benefit and harm. Exploratory independent-cycle evaluation, not untouched confirmation, physiological mechanism identification, or a clinical diagnostic test.
